profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Gap Inc.
profile.summary:
Lead / Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) - | Java | Kotlin | Android | blockchain
Scrum Master / IT Project Manager: applying Process Group: Initiating, Planning, Executing, Monitoring and Controlling & Closing, with Knowledge Areas as Integration, Scope, Time, Cost, Quality, Human Resource, Communications, Risk, Procurement, Stakeholder. | Agile | ITIL | CCMI Dev | SCRUM | PRINCE2 | PMP | - [Profile 2]

Patterns:	MVC, MVP, MVVM, 3-Layer, N-Tier & Clean Architecture.
Kotlin:		Kotlin with Android
Java: 		Java SE, Java EE Java with Android
Mobile:		Android
Basic:		C & C++
Web:		HTML5, & CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery & AJAX.
Databases:	MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server.
Servers:	Apache, Tomcat & Glass Fish.

7+ years’ experience in the Information Technologies field.
4+ years’ experience in Android.
3+ years’ experience as IT Project Manager.
7+ years’ experience in Java SE & Java EE.
4 published apps in the Google Play Store.

Tools: |Jira |Eclipse, IntelliJ, Android Studio, Glassfish, |GitHub, Jenkins, Travis CI |Agile, SCRUM, TDD |

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: My most recent project was with General Motors, where I served on an eleven-member team dedicated to implementing the GM AppShop a catalog of downloadable apps designed to run on the infotainment system of a vehicle. Using the best practices to build software.

positions.title: Java Software Developer
positions.description:
| JavaEE | JSP | Servlet | Struts | Spring | Hibernate |Oracle | Tomcat/Glassfish |

•	Analysis and design of a web-based application that enabled the drilling and production of oil. Coordinated a team  of 5 Java programmers to (Drilling, CERPLAY System, Shell gas).
•	Design and development of new functionality for CERPLAY, a General Oil System’s business application. It is a  JAVA EE system used by PEMEX to control their drilling and production of oil.  
•	Software development activities including design, code development, testing, profiling, optimisation, troubleshooting.
•	Participate in overall system design, planning, implementation and troubleshooting; and Contribute to the development of system documentation and processes
